+// executeReturnFromGraveyardManaValueOrLess implements the
+// return_from_graveyard_mana_value_filter primitive (ticket
+// engine.auto-return-from-graveyard-mana-value-filter-40a5f5303a, Raise the
+// Past class): "Return all creature cards with mana value 2 or less from
+// your graveyard to the battlefield." Unlike
+// executeReturnFromGraveyardManaValueX's exact-equality X match, this
+// primitive returns EVERY card in the controller's own graveyard whose mana
+// value (Card.ManaCost.CMC(), the same read
+// executeDestroyAllArtifactsManaValueXOrLess above uses) is LESS THAN OR
+// EQUAL TO a fixed threshold (effectValue["mana_value_max"]), further
+// narrowed by an optional effectValue["card_type"] filter — "creature"
+// checks Card.IsCreature() directly (the same method
+// executeReturnFromGraveyardManaValueX filters on), any other non-empty
+// value falls back to matchesPermanentFilter, the same generic type-bucket
+// matcher executeTapVariableAmountXEffect's filter uses, and an empty
+// card_type matches every card. This is a non-targeted, all-matching
+// return: every card meeting both filters returns to the battlefield under
+// its owner's control in one resolution, not a single chosen target — the
+// pre-existing single-target, card_type-only executeReturnFromGraveyard
+// path is untouched by this addition. Matches are collected before
+// mutating the graveyard so removal doesn't skip entries while iterating a
+// shrinking zone.
+func (gs *GameState) executeReturnFromGraveyardManaValueOrLess(controller int, effectValue map[string]interface{}) error {
+	if controller < 0 || controller >= len(gs.Players) {
+		return nil
+	}
+	threshold := 0
+	switch v := effectValue["mana_value_max"].(type) {
+	case int:
+		threshold = v
+	case float64:
+		threshold = int(v)
+	}
+	cardType := getStringValue(effectValue, "card_type", "")
+	var matches []*Card
+	for _, c := range gs.Players[controller].Graveyard.GetAll() {
+		if c == nil || c.ManaCost.CMC() > threshold {
+			continue
+		}
+		switch cardType {
+		case "":
+		case "creature":
+			if !c.IsCreature() {
+				continue
+			}
+		default:
+			if !matchesPermanentFilter(c, cardType) {
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		matches = append(matches, c)
+	}
+	for _, c := range matches {
+		gs.Players[controller].Graveyard.RemoveCard(c.ID)
+		c.Owner = controller
+		c.Controller = controller
+		gs.Battlefield.AddCard(c)
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package game
+
+import "testing"
+
+// Raise the Past class (ticket
+// engine.auto-return-from-graveyard-mana-value-filter-40a5f5303a): "Return
+// all creature cards with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the
+// battlefield." Exercises executeReturnFromGraveyardManaValueOrLess
+// directly against a graveyard containing cards above, at, and below the
+// threshold, plus an opponent's graveyard card that must never move.
+func TestReturnFromGraveyardManaValueOrLess(t *testing.T) {
+	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
+
+	cheap := NewCreature("Cheap Beast", ManaCost{Generic: 1}, 1, 1, 0)
+	gs.Players[0].Graveyard.AddCard(cheap)
+
+	onThreshold := NewCreature("Threshold Beast", ManaCost{Generic: 2}, 2, 2, 0)
+	gs.Players[0].Graveyard.AddCard(onThreshold)
+
+	pricey := NewCreature("Pricey Beast", ManaCost{Generic: 3}, 3, 3, 0)
+	gs.Players[0].Graveyard.AddCard(pricey)
+
+	oppCheap := NewCreature("Opponent Cheap Beast", ManaCost{Generic: 1}, 1, 1, 1)
+	gs.Players[1].Graveyard.AddCard(oppCheap)
+
+	if err := gs.executeReturnFromGraveyardManaValueOrLess(0, map[string]interface{}{
+		"mana_value_max": 2,
+		"card_type":      "creature",
+	}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("executeReturnFromGraveyardManaValueOrLess: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	onBattlefield := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, c := range gs.Battlefield.GetAll() {
+		onBattlefield[c.Name] = true
+	}
+	if !onBattlefield["Cheap Beast"] {
+		t.Fatalf("expected Cheap Beast (mana value 1) to return to the battlefield")
+	}
+	if !onBattlefield["Threshold Beast"] {
+		t.Fatalf("expected Threshold Beast (mana value 2) to return to the battlefield")
+	}
+	if onBattlefield["Pricey Beast"] {
+		t.Fatalf("Pricey Beast (mana value 3) must NOT return — above the mana value 2 threshold")
+	}
+	if onBattlefield["Opponent Cheap Beast"] {
+		t.Fatalf("opponent's graveyard card must not be returned by controller 0's effect")
+	}
+
+	remaining := gs.Players[0].Graveyard.GetAll()
+	if len(remaining) != 1 || remaining[0].Name != "Pricey Beast" {
+		t.Fatalf("expected only Pricey Beast to remain in the graveyard, got %v", remaining)
+	}
+}
